review: One research agent derived and checked the update. Checks include an independent regular 24-gon integral comparison, irregular rational circles tested with a different convex kernel, exact capacity identities, full prior replay, independent summation by parts, invalid-input rejection, fixed-tail inequalities and extracted offline replay. No independent-agent or external peer review is claimed.
acceptance: Four new and twenty-four prior standard-library exact entries; active checks under -O, fixed input bytes and extracted package replay.
limitations: Convex perspective, support lines, radial weak convergence and Gram duality are standard tools; no invention, optimal-constant or global priority claim.
The >0.556 result retains the stated external input and has no certified finite starting n. The >0.513 result is asymptotic; the finite all-tail statement has coefficient 0.51 and n>=10^14.
Artificial layer mass is not a claim of that many distinct physical edges. Actual pair losses are assigned disjointly before convex relaxation.
Restricted affine lines are used only at capacity-controlled artificial arguments, never at arbitrary actual pair distances.
A same-h Dirichlet measurement is required when combining angular, radial and Gaussian tests; different smearing budgets cannot simply be added.
No general finite-n optimal configuration, full n8 sharp theorem, n100 five-layer theorem or microscopic lattice classification.
